statement.p: Are the following statements true or false?

li.p: A parametrization of the graph of y = \ln(x) for x > 0 is given by x = e^t, y = t for -\infty \lt t \lt \infty.
The line parametrized by x = 7, y = 5t, z = 6 + t is parallel to the x-axis.
The parametric curve x = (3t+4)^2, y = 5(3t+4)^2-9, for 0 \leq t \leq 3 is a line segment.

solution.p: 1. Substituting x = e^t, y = t into the equation y= \ln(x) yields t = \ln(e^t) = t. For the given values of t, x > 0. Thus the statement is True.
2. The direction vector of the line is \langle 0, 5, 1\rangle. This vector is not parallel to the x-axis. Thus the statement is False.
3. Eliminating the parameter t yields the equation y = 5x -9,\; 16 \le x \le 169. Thus the parametric curve is a line segment and the statement is True.
